name: Helpful Assistance
text: On Reveal: Execute all 4 of H.E.R.B.I.E.'s abilities here.

name: Sam Wilson Captain America
text: On Reveal: Add Cap's Shield to another location. Ongoing: Cap's Shield is Moveable.

name: X-23
text: When Discarded or Destroyed: Regenerate this at a random location and you get +1 Energy next turn.

name: Soul Stone
text: On Reveal: Draw a card. Ongoing: Thanos can't be discarded or destroyed.

name: Jane Foster Mighty Thor
text: On Reveal: Draw all cards that cost 0 from your deck.

name: Mind Stone
text: On Reveal: Draw 2 Stones from your deck.

name: Blob
text: On Reveal: Merge cards from your deck into this until it gains 13 or more Power.

name: Vibranium Mines
text: After you play here, shuffle 3 Vibranium into your deck.

name: Attilan
text: After turn 3, shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw 3 cards.

name: Arishem
text: Game Start: Shuffle 12 new cards into your deck. On turn 3, get +1 Max Energy.

name: Venus
text: When your cards in play are Empowered, give those cards an additional +1 Power.

name: Sub-Mariner
text: When this is Empowered, add a random 1-Cost character to your hand with that same increase. (if in hand or in play)

name: Starlight Citadel
text: After turn 4, swap the position of each location.

name: Quake
text: On Reveal: Swap the positions of the other two locations.

name: Toxin
text: On Reveal: Return your other cards here to your hand. +2 Power for each returned.

name: Boomerang
text: When this returns to your hand, randomly steal 4 Power from characters in your opponent's hand. Activate: Return this to your hand.

name: Onslaught
text: Ongoing: Your other Ongoing effects here apply an additional time.

name: Onslaught's Citadel
text: Ongoing effects here apply an additional time.

name: Black Vortex
text: The next card you play here becomes a random 6-Cost card.

name: Gamma Lab
text: After turn 3, transform all cards here into the Hulk.

name: Zombie Galacti
text: Game Start: Choose 6 other characters in your deck. On Reveal: Transform those cards into copies of this.

name: Morph
text: On Reveal: Become a copy of a card in your opponent's hand.

name: Murderworld
text: After turn 3, destroy all cards here.

name: Widow's Kiss
text: Destroy this when your side of this location is full.

name: Mole Man
text: On Reveal: Banish the top card of your deck. Add 2 Rocks to your hand. Set their Power to the banished card's Cost.

name: Hala
text: After turn 4, destroy all cards on the losing side here.

name: Thor - Avengers
text: On Reveal: Draw an Avenger, then shuffle Mjolnir into your deck.

name: Kitty Pryde
text: Start of Turn: Return this to your hand. When this returns to your hand, +1 Power.

name: Agamotto
text: Game Start: Shuffle 4 Ancient Arcana into your deck.

name: Falcon
text: On Reveal: Return your 1-Cost cards to your hand.

name: Beta Ray Bill
text: On Reveal: Shuffle Stormbreaker into your deck.

name: Overdrive Reactor Effect04
text: Transform charged cards in play into ones that cost 1 more.

name: Polymorph
text: On Reveal: Transform your lowest-Power character here into one that costs 1 more.

name: Westview
text: Turns into a new location on turn 4.

name: Tarnax IV
text: After you play a character here, transform it into another one of the same Cost.

name: Images of Ikonn
text: On Reveal: Transform your other cards here into copies of the highest-Power one.

name: Iceman
text: On Reveal: Give a card in your opponent's hand +1 Cost. (maximum 6)

name: Sandman
text: On Reveal: Next turn, cards cost 1 more. (maximum 6)

name: The Sandbar
text: Created cards cost 1 more. (max 6)

name: Witchfire
text: On Reveal: Your opponent draws a card, increase its cost by 1.

name: Askani'son
text: Activate: Create a 1-Cost card at another location. Increase the Cost each time you're winning here as the turn starts.

name: Korg
text: On Reveal: Shuffle a Rock into your opponent's deck.

name: White Widow
text: On Reveal: Add a Widow's Kiss to your opponent's side of this location.

name: Maximus
text: On Reveal: Your opponent draws 2 cards.

name: Red Skull
text: Ongoing: Enemy cards here have +2 Power.

name: Munchineworld
text: After you play a card here, your opponent gets a Chimichanga.

name: Los Diablos Base
text: After turn 3, ruin a random location.

name: Galactus
text: On Reveal: If you're winning this location and this is your only card here, destroy all other locations.

name: Worldship
text: Destroy the other locations.

name: Flooding
text: This is the last turn cards can be played here.

name: Loki
text: On Reveal: Replace your deck with your opponent's starting deck. Give those cards -1 Cost.

name: Crystal Towers
text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw 3 cards.

name: District X
text: Replace both decks with 10 random cards.

name: Crown City
text: Whoever is winning here gets +4 Power at adjacent locations.

name: Mad Thinker
text: Start of Turn (after drawing): +2 Power if your hand is full.

name: Atlantis
text: If you only have one card here, it has +5 Power.

name: Namor
text: Ongoing: +5 Power if this is your only card here.

name: Juggernaut Horseman of War
text: Objective: Have 6 different Powers among your other cards in play +6 Power. (0/6)

name: Gambit Horseman of Death
text: Objective: Play 6 total Cost of created cards Randomly destroy up to 3 total Cost of enemy cards. (0/6)

name: The Abbey
text: First to put exactly 2 cards here draws a card.

name: The Sacred Timeline
text: First to fill this gets a copy of their opening hand.

name: White Hot Room
text: First to fill this gets +3 Max Energy.

name: Random
text: On Reveal: Set this card's Power equal to the Power of a random card in your deck.

name: Stick
text: On Reveal: Give the next card you play Power equal to this card's Power.

name: Lasher
text: Activate: Afflict an enemy card here with negative Power equal to this card's Power.

name: Taskmaster
text: On Reveal: Set this card's Power equal to that of the last card you played. (if able)

name: Clobberin' Time
text: Costs 1 less for each different Cost among your cards in play. On Reveal: Give your Champion +8 Power.

name: Kluh
text: On Reveal: EACH player randomly gives a card in their hand -1 Cost for each different Cost among their cards in play.

name: Toxie Doxie - Thunderbolts
text: On Reveal: Give 2 characters in your hand +3 Power. You can't play them next turn unless they're Thunderbolts.

name: Lady Bullseye
text: On Reveal: Afflict an enemy card with -2 Power. Repeat on a different enemy for each of your unspent Energy.

name: The Grub
text: Add a random Food Fight variant to each player's hand.

name: Central Park
text: Add a Squirrel to each location.

name: High Evolutionary
text: Game Start: Unlock the potential of your cards with no abilities.

name: Patriot
text: Ongoing: Your cards with no abilities have +2 Power.

name: Ant Man
text: Ongoing: If your side of this location is full, +4 Power.

name: Reed's Lab
text: +1 Energy each turn if your side here is full.

name: Ice Cube
text: Start of Turn: +1 Energy. Then destroy this if your side is full here.

name: Our Lady of Saints
text: When your revealed cards fill this, merge them into a Symbiote.

name: Ultron Soul Stone
text: On Reveal: For each of your full locations, give one of your cards there +3 Power.

name: Marrow
text: When Discarded or Destroyed: Randomly split -7 Power among enemy cards.

name: The Living Tribunal
text: Ongoing: Split your total Power evenly among all locations.

name: Bishop
text: After you play a card, this gains +1 Power.

name: Wolverine Horseman of War
text: Objective: This has 5 or more Power Give one of your cards at each location +4 Power. (3/5)

name: Zombie Giant-Man
text: On Reveal: Horde +2, then this gains Power equal to your Zombie Horde.

name: Miek
text: When you discard a card, this gains +1 Power and Moveable next turn.

name: Havok
text: End of Turn: You lose 1 Max Energy and this gains +3 Power.

name: SP//dr
text: On Reveal: Merge this into one of your cards here. It's Moveable next turn.

name: Symbiote Spider-Man - Spider-Verse
text: Activate: Merge one of your cards here into this. Replace that card with a Spider-Verse card from your deck.

name: Sinister Six
text: Game Start: The first 6 characters you draw are EVIL! After you play them all, merge them into this and add this to the last one's location. (0/6)

name: Peni Parker
text: On Reveal: Add SP//dr to your hand. When this merges, you get +1 Energy next turn.

name: Strange Supreme
text: Gains +2 Power from merging. End of Turn: Merge one of your created cards into this.

name: Symbiote Spider-Man
text: Activate: Merge your lowest-Cost card here into this. Copy its text like it just revealed.

name: Klyntar
text: After turn 4, merge your cards here into a Symbiote.

name: Limbo
text: There is a turn 7 this game.

name: Energy and game length
text: Energy each turn equals the turn number and does not carry over; the game lasts 6 turns.

name: Sandcastle
text: After turn 5, end the game.

name: Electro
text: On Reveal: +1 Max Energy. Ongoing: You can only play 1 card a turn.

name: Debrii
text: On Reveal: Add a Rock to each other location.

name: Inevitable
text: On Reveal: If your Champion is in play with 20 or more Power, destroy front-row enemy cards here. (even unrevealed ones)

name: Topaz
text: After you play a card here, move it to the middle location.

name: Grand Master
text: On Reveal: Move one of your other On Reveal cards here to the middle location. Its ability happens again.

name: Zombie Sentry
text: On Reveal: Horde +1 for each of your cards at the right location.

name: Giganto
text: You can only play this at the left location.

name: Crimson Behemoth
text: On Reveal: Steal all the Power of a front-row enemy card here.

name: Apocalypse, Celestials' Chosen
text: On Reveal: Swap the lowest-Power character in your front row at any location with one from your deck.

name: Mosh Pit
text: End of Turn: Give front-row cards here +1 Power.

name: Mephisto
text: If you win this game, double your winnings.

name: Ajax
text: Ongoing: +1 Power for each card in play afflicted with negative Power.

name: Ikari
text: You can only play this where an enemy is afflicted with negative Power.

name: Polaris Horseman of Pestilence
text: Objective: Cards in play are afflicted with -5 Power Put a card from your hand here. (0/5)

name: Diamondback
text: Ongoing: Enemy cards here afflicted with negative Power have an additional -2 Power.

name: Caliban Horseman of Pestilence
text: Objective: Have 3 cards that are 4-Cost or more in play Afflict the highest-Cost enemy card with -7 Power. (0/3)

name: Goblin Queen
text: On Reveal: Other cards can't be revealed this turn.

name: Supergiant
text: On Reveal: All cards played next turn don't reveal until the game ends.

name: Invisible Woman
text: Ongoing: Cards you play here are not revealed until the game ends.

name: Captain Marvel
text: At the end of the game, move to a location that wins you the game. (If possible)

name: Malekith
text: On Reveal: Add a 3-Cost or less card from your deck here, but don't reveal it until the game ends.

name: Start of Turn
text: Triggers at the start of each turn while the card is on the board.
